title: Passage and Current
author: I. M. Thackeray
blurb: Bram Kavanagh, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
